items.title: 13 Hospitalized After Airport Bus Crashes Into Concrete Wall At EWR
items.summary: Thirteen people were hospitalized after an employee shuttle bus crashed into a concrete wall at Newark Liberty International Airport.

items.title: Air Cargo Demand Grows 3.9% in July
items.summary: IATA released data for July 2026 global air cargo markets showing growth in all regions, with airlines in Asia-Pacific, Europe, and North America accounting for more than 90% of the overall increase.

items.title: Air Passenger Demand Grows 0.2% in July
items.summary: IATA released data for July 2026 global passenger demand, showing a mostly positive Northern summer travel season, despite year-on-year declines in North America and the Middle East.

items.title: FAA Announces Key Demonstrations with the First Remotely-Piloted Hybrid-Electric Flight for Cargo Shipment
items.summary: WASHINGTON — The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that Elroy and the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight to test cargo deliveries using remotely piloted aircraft at Houma-Terrebonne Airport in Louisiana. This is the first remotely piloted aircraft test flight under the FAA’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) .
